limitations: Baseline extraction has no measured precision or recall.
Modern name queries are seeded demonstrations, not resolved identities of Culpeper chapters.
Capped evidence samples cannot establish first-tested, first-confirmed or never-tested status.
Annual effort snapshots do not constitute complete research effort histories.
No automated proposal is a human audit or calibrated probability.
Historical dates and edition attribution require review.
German OCR uses a bilingual lexicon with unreviewed commentary boundaries.
Paul proposals exclude text after explicit Commentary markers but botanical scope remains unreviewed.
Balkan table spans reference a whitelisted normalised projection linked to the original licensed JATS hash.
Abstract text remains only in ignored local cache.

external_check.normalization: Case and whitespace only; caller must harmonize taxonomy and counting unit.
external_check.reason: A verified reference list with provenance is required; the published total of 105 is not a gold list.

identity_calibration.zero_probability_policy: Floor zero or below-epsilon probabilities to the explicit epsilon before log scaling, then renormalize. Other/unresolved candidates are preserved.
identity_calibration.split: Caller-supplied disjoint expert identity groups; no random split.
limitations: Temperature rescales supplied probabilities; it cannot resolve missing candidates or prove taxonomic identity.
Top-label ECE depends on binning and sample size; a held-out improvement is not guaranteed.
Expert label quality and applicability across languages/eras require a separate audit.
identity_calibration.reason: Each disjoint expert split needs at least 20 reviewed identity groups.
